title: Email: Fw: Few reminders as ST starts

content.subject: Fw: Few reminders as ST starts

content.text:
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Saturday, February 9, 2019 7:00 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Few reminders as ST starts 
 
Got this. Roger that. I will be ready for your note.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Saturday, February 9, 2019 2:49:54 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Cc: Crawford, Kirkland
Subject: Few reminders as ST starts 
 
Hey, Anthony: As you’re filing stories in Lakeland, please keep in mind some of our story-optimization protocols.

I need you to fill out a recommended headline, front headline and page title for non-breaking stories. You’ve done fine with the briefs, but try to dial in the other things.  Also, I need you to start adding at least two inline links in your stories, and any requisite videos or photos.

Speaking of video, please plan to produce a few each week while you’re in Lakeland. Whether it’s a standup of you breaking down the day or an interview with a certain player, we need to make sure we’re keeping a steady flow of video coming.
I’ll send a note this evening highlighting some things we could do in addition to any thoughts you have.
